title: Create Invitation schema
description: Create new Invitation schema in app/schema/Invitation.ts with fields: contactId, invitationCode, dxosInvitationId, status, createdAt, revokedAt, acceptedAt. This is the foundation for the new contact-first invitation flow.

comments.author: Ralph
comments.text: Created app/schema/Invitation.ts with fields: contactId, invitationCode, dxosInvitationId, status (pending/accepted/revoked), createdAt, revokedAt, acceptedAt. Added InvitationId branded type and make() factory function. Updated CLAUDE.md to include Invitation in schema list.

title: Create add contact route
description: Create app/routes/_private+/team+/members+/add.tsx route that uses AddContactDialog to create contacts before inviting

title: Write tests for invitation flow
description: Create unit tests (app/schema/tests/Invitation.test.ts) and E2E tests (test/invitation-flow.test.ts, test/revoke-invitation.test.ts, test/backward-compatibility.test.ts)

title: Update Contact schema for pre-created contacts
description: Make Contact.identityId optional (populated after join), update ExtendedContact to include invitation property, update isMember getter to check Boolean(identityId)

title: Create AddContactDialog component
description: Create app/ui/AddContactDialog.tsx with form fields: firstName (required), lastName, userName (required), avatarUrl (optional). Follow existing dialog patterns.

title: Update Members UI for contact-first workflow
description: Update app/ui/Members.tsx and app/routes/_private+/team+/members+/_members.tsx to add 'Add contact' button, change 'Invite' to navigate per contact, show accurate status based on invitation records

title: Register Invitation schema in root.tsx
description: Add Invitation to the types array in ClientProvider in app/root.tsx

title: Update join flow to match invitations to contacts
description: CRITICAL: Update app/routes/auth+/setup+/_.join.().tsx to query for Invitation record, match to pre-created contact, update contact.identityId, mark invitation as ACCEPTED. Maintain backward compatibility by auto-creating contact if no invitation record exists.

title: Update invitation flow to invite specific contacts
description: Rename invite.tsx to invite.().tsx. Update to create both DXOS invitation and Invitation record linking code to contact. Update invitation record with code from useInvitationStatus.

title: Update useTeam hook for invitation data
description: Update app/hooks/useTeam.tsx to query Invitation records, pass invitation to ExtendedContact constructor, compute invitation status

title: Implement invitation revoke functionality
description: Create app/routes/_private+/team+/members+/revoke.().tsx and app/ui/RevokeInvitationDialog.tsx. Cancel DXOS invitation and update Invitation record status to REVOKED.
